instructions.name: add_collateral
docs: Add collateral to an existing credit line (also reactivates inactive credit lines)

instructions.name: borrow
docs: Borrow funds from the pool (sent to borrower)

accounts.name: borrower_token_account
docs: Borrower's USDC token account (receives the borrowed funds)

instructions.name: borrow_and_pay
docs: Borrow funds and pay directly to a recipient

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Recipient's USDC token account (receives the payment)

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit USDC into the lending pool

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initialize the entire protocol: CreditManager, LendingPool, ReputationManager, and all vaults

accounts.name: pool_vault
docs: Pool vault for lender deposits and borrows

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Liquidate a borrower's position (admin only, when over LTV or overdue)

accounts.name: reputation_data
docs: Per-user reputation data. init_if_needed since liquidation may be first reputation interaction.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: Collateral vault (collateral stays in vault — no transfer on liquidation)

accounts.name: pool_vault
docs: Pool vault (seized collateral gets transferred here to cover bad debt)

instructions.name: open_credit_line
docs: Open a new credit line with collateral deposit

accounts.name: reputation_data
docs: Per-user reputation data. init_if_needed since first repay may be first reputation interaction.

instructions.name: update_parameters
docs: Update credit protocol parameters (interest rate, reputation threshold, credit multiplier)

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw USDC from the lending pool (interest deducted first, then principal)

instructions.name: withdraw_collateral
docs: Withdraw collateral (only when no outstanding debt)

accounts.name: pool_vault
docs: Pool vault (interest may come from here)

types.name: CollateralInfo
docs: Per-borrower collateral tracking (PDA seeded by borrower pubkey)

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Reward debt for O(1) accumulator pattern

types.name: CreditLine
docs: Per-borrower credit line (PDA seeded by borrower pubkey)

fields.name: interest_accrued
docs: Accrued interest on the borrowed amount

fields.name: repayment_due_date
docs: Deadline for full repayment (grace + repayment window)

fields.name: is_active
docs: Whether this credit line is active

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer: pending new admin

fields.name: fixed_interest_rate
docs: Fixed annual interest rate in basis points (e.g. 1500 = 15%)

fields.name: reputation_threshold
docs: Reputation score threshold for credit increase eligibility

fields.name: credit_increase_multiplier
docs: Credit increase multiplier in basis points (e.g. 12000 = 120%)

types.name: LenderInfo
docs: Per-lender deposit tracking (PDA seeded by lender pubkey)

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Reward debt for O(1) accumulator pattern: deposited * acc_per_share at last settlement

fields.name: protocol_fees_collected
docs: Protocol fees collected (held in pool vault)

fields.name: accumulated_interest_per_share
docs: Global O(1) interest accumulator (scaled by PRECISION = 1e12)

types.name: ReputationData
docs: Per-user reputation data (PDA seeded by user pubkey)

fields.name: is_initialized
docs: Whether the user has been initialized in the reputation system

fields.name: max_score_change
docs: Maximum score change in a single update

fields.name: is_paused
docs: Whether the reputation system is paused
